compiled_state.title: [completion-verifier]: Validation-class SC override permits silent inheritance gap -> Closure cascade drops validation responsibility
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 5d5f6e904dd3c8d731c8fcd956fb288790b884c9
* **Skill/Agent:** plugins/dso/agents/completion-verifier.md (and skill plugins/dso/skills/completion-verifier/SKILL.md)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker (planning-model defect)

**Filed by d076 post-mortem analysis (`docs/findings/d076-postmortem-analysis.md`) — implementation deferred to a remediation sprint.**

#### Expected Behavior

When completion-verifier returns FACTUAL FAIL on a validation-class success criterion (an SC whose entire purpose is end-to-end exercise — typically the last SC in the epic spec, named "validation acceptance" or similar, and explicitly requiring a real-world exercise), the override pathway must require: (a) a successor-epic ID exists in `open` status that explicitly inherits the failing SC as one of its own success criteria; (b) the successor is linked back via `relates_to` with a "validation-inheritor" relation comment. Without (a)+(b), closure is refused even with user override. Validation-class SCs are a distinct verdict class from collectible-evidence SCs and are not eligible for the standard override pathway.

#### Actual Behavior

f61f-7e0a-36d3-4e7d SC8 was the explicit end-to-end validation SC ("validation sprint of at least 1500 total changed LOC across at least 3 stories runs the entire pipeline end-to-end"). completion-verifier verdict was FACTUAL FAIL. User authorized override on 2026-05-12 with the rationale "DD1 (real validation sprint pass) → override applied" and named two blocking bugs. Both blocking bugs are now closed but no validation sprint ever ran on the f61f architecture; d076 became the de-facto successor but its success criteria do not include "exercise the f61f architecture end-to-end." The validation responsibility was lost in the closure cascade.

Additionally, commit 8df0867531 created docs/findings/validation-sprint-artificial-marker.md whose own message reads "This commit does not represent real story implementation — it exists solely to produce the per-story CI review artifact required by the DD2 mechanical proxies." This artificial-validation workaround was permitted to satisfy mechanical proxies even though the author knew the architecture could not actually satisfy SC8.

### 3. Action History

f61f closed 2026-05-12 with SC8 FACTUAL FAIL. d076 closed 2026-05-15. PR #140 (the de-facto end-to-end exercise) landed in main 2026-05-16 — i.e., AFTER both supposedly-completed epics. No epic on record has SC "exercise per-story PR architecture on a real ci-pr sprint."

### 4. Chronological Rationalization

A two-tier verdict model (collectible-evidence-gap vs. feature-doesn't-work) plus a successor-handoff requirement is cheap and prevents the silent inheritance gap that drove the d076 rescue.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

Affected agent: completion-verifier. Affected skill: completion-verifier SKILL.md (closure protocol). Affected workflow: epic-closure path in /dso:sprint Phase I.

### 6. Logs

Reference: docs/findings/d076-postmortem-analysis.md §5 (completion-verifier diagnosis) + §6 row 6.

comments.body:
**Scope sharpened by d076 post-mortem (2026-05-16):** The fix is more specific than the original ticket described. Three concrete amendments to completion-verifier:

1. **Categorize every FACTUAL FAIL verdict** into one of:
   - **(A) External blocker** — failure root-causes to a separately-trackable dependency
   - **(B) Internal architecture gap** — failure root-causes to scope this epic was supposed to deliver but didn't
   - **(C) Evidence not yet collected** — feature works, evidence pending
2. **Refuse override on (B).** Internal-architecture-gap failures are not overrideable; the epic stays open until scope is delivered or formally re-scoped via successor epic.
3. **Refuse mechanical-proxy satisfaction for artificial-validation commits.** Any commit on a branch matching `*/validation-artificial*` or whose commit message contains "does not represent real story implementation" must invalidate the mechanical proxies derived from it. See evidence commit `8df0867531` and `docs/findings/validation-sprint-artificial-marker.md`.

The complementary orchestrator-presentation amendment is filed as a separate bug (sprint Phase I) — that bug depends on this one because it needs the category enum to surface.

Reference: `docs/findings/d076-postmortem-analysis.md` §5.2 + §5.3 + §5.4.
